newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIAN EX-CHAMPIONS EXPELLED FROM CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIAN EX-CHAMPIONS EXPELLED FROM CUP.

text.p: Former Bulgarian champions Levski Sofia have been expelled from the League Cup for refusing to play a match, newspapers said on Wednesday.
Levski Sofia boycotted their first match in the tournament against CSKA last Saturday because they opposed the choice of referee Dimitar Momirov, who was appointed by the Bulgarian Football Union.
The union's sports and technical committee said the team had violated its regulations and banned them from the tournament.
Levski's management accused Momirov of biased refereeing during a first division match against Neftohimik.
Newspapers quoted Levski Sofia president Tomas Lavchis as saying Bulgarian football was corrupt and the Football Union management should resign.
Levski Sofia are currently second in Bulgaria's soccer championship.
